notes.title: Visionarium 3 Fundraiser
notes.notes:
Hello fellow VR psychonauts,

I'm calling out from the depths of the matrix, to gather support for a third chapter of Visionarium. 

I'm having lots of new ideas and things that I have learned that I want to integrate into a new experiment.

If you liked playing Visionarium and would like to see the journey continue please check out the fundraiser here : [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/visionarium-3/x/22929384#/]Visionarium 3 Fundraiser[/url] , Any contribution allows me to put more of my time and energie into this new project. Many thanks!

notes.title: Added extra audio settings pop up
notes.notes: Added extra audio settings check so users are aware of the right settings in the oculus home app to have audio input not being blocked by oculus which can result in a infinite loop at the start.

notes.title: Loop Issue Bug
notes.notes:
I'm aware that some of you have problems with audio output not registering in the game causing the game to loop at the start. 

One way to fix this is to check if your sound is only going to the headset and not to your windows sound driver. To check this go into your oculus app. select Devices and click on your headset. Then make sure that if you have the audio of the headset selected that "Hear VR Audio from your computer" is turned on.  You can also just switch to "Use windows settings" for both audio and microphone.

I know it is not ideal and I'm trying to fix it.

If you still experience issues leave a message on the discord server. :[url=https://discord.gg/BxNS9dqA]Visionarium Discord[/url]
